urn:epoch:document-adapter:provisional-a.title: ProvisionalAdapterDefinition
urn:epoch:document-adapter:provisional-a.description: Provisional adapter definition: the mapping candidate with complete five-stage evidence provenance and its W007 registration plan; terminal lifecycle.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:record-versio.title: DocumentRecordVersion
urn:epoch:document-adapter:record-versio.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized document-adapter document (currently 1).

urn:epoch:document-adapter:definition-id.title: DefinitionId
urn:epoch:document-adapter:definition-id.description: Opaque, content-derived provisional-definition identity: "docmap:" + 64 lowercase hex characters.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:tenant-scope.title: TenantScope
urn:epoch:document-adapter:tenant-scope.description: Tenant scoping: owning tenant plus optional workspace/project narrowing.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:tenant-id.title: TenantId
urn:epoch:document-adapter:tenant-id.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:workspace-id.title: WorkspaceId
urn:epoch:document-adapter:workspace-id.description: Opaque workspace identity: "workspace:" followed by a lowercase slug.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:project-id.title: ProjectId
urn:epoch:document-adapter:project-id.description: Opaque project identity: "project:" followed by a lowercase slug.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:extraction-ca.title: ExtractionCandidate
urn:epoch:document-adapter:extraction-ca.description: Typed mapping candidate derived deterministically from a content-addressed document: field locator onto W002 semantic target.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:candidate-id.title: CandidateId
urn:epoch:document-adapter:candidate-id.description: Opaque, content-derived mapping-candidate identity: "cand:" + 64 lowercase hex characters.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:document-fiel.title: DocumentFieldLocator
urn:epoch:document-adapter:document-fiel.description: Document field locator: format, stable source path, and (text form) 1-based line.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:source-path.title: SourcePath
urn:epoch:document-adapter:source-path.description: Stable identifier of a document field inside a typed document form.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:semantic-type.title: SemanticTypeKey
urn:epoch:document-adapter:semantic-type.description: W002 world-model semantic namespace type key (namespace:name); the core namespace is reserved for kernel vocabulary.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:property-mapp.title: PropertyMapping
urn:epoch:document-adapter:property-mapp.description: One property-level mapping from a document property onto a semantic property.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:property-name.title: PropertyName
urn:epoch:document-adapter:property-name.description: Document property name (source and semantic sides), W002 property-name grammar.

QualifiedTypeReference.title: QualifiedTypeReference
QualifiedTypeReference.description: Reference to a versioned, protocol-defined type: dot-namespaced id plus semver core version.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:stage-evidenc.title: StageEvidenceChain
urn:epoch:document-adapter:stage-evidenc.description: Ordered stage evidence chain: a prefix of the derivation pipeline, every link a W006 evidence record anchored to the document digest.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:stage-evidenc.title: StageEvidenceLink
urn:epoch:document-adapter:stage-evidenc.description: One stage evidence link: derivation stage plus the content address of its W006 evidence record.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:extraction-st.title: ExtractionStageKind
urn:epoch:document-adapter:extraction-st.description: Derivation stage: uploaded, parsed, candidates-extracted, review-pending, provisional (terminal).

urn:epoch:document-adapter:provisional-r.title: ProvisionalRegistrationPlan
urn:epoch:document-adapter:provisional-r.description: W007 source-category registration plan: derived plans carry category source and origin provisional-document-derived; the policy is enforced at build time.

CapabilityCategory.title: CapabilityCategory
CapabilityCategory.description: Capability Fabric adapter category: source, semantic, reconstruction, visualization, simulation, evaluator, action, or verification.

CapabilityOrigin.title: CapabilityOrigin
CapabilityOrigin.description: Where a registered capability originates: first-party, community, external software, or provisional document-derived.
